title: AutoAgent: Autonomous Agent Engineering and Harness Optimization
relevance_note: A production-relevant framework that implements the 'meta-agent' pattern for autonomous agent engineering. It separates the human steer (program.md) from the machine iteration (agent.py). High-fidelity evidence of the shift from manual coding to 'steering the generator'.
reason_included: Provides a reference implementation of the autonomous loop that directly addresses the '80% plumbing' problem of building robust agentic systems.

claim_snippets.claim_text: By programming the meta-agent (program.md) rather than the harness (agent.py), engineers can achieve higher benchmark scores through automated iteration.
